smoke.description: Fast health check: wallet discovery UI plus read-only API contract checks.

api.description: API tests: authentication, permissions, validation, duplicates, state and balances. Write checks run only where the environment allows writes.

regression.description: Wallet UI regression and connection recovery checks.

uat.description: Automated UAT journeys from the WEB MPC local scenario suite (connect, dig, send cart, confirm, recover) against the isolated stack.

load.description: Controlled k6 load against the isolated stack, compared with the stored baseline and agreed thresholds.

full.description: smoke + api + regression + uat + load in one run.

critical-smoke.description: Critical read-only API checks and three account-access UAT journeys.

nightly-regression.description: Full API and UAT including application scenarios; load runs separately.
